description: LOCK files: seal each one as <file>.ndc (AES-256-GCM, sealed to this device's key, which never leaves this machine). Every seal belongs to someone: it is registered at NoData under this computer's approved identity, NoData keeps only a key half it cannot open, and every opening is receipted and revocable. Refuses when this computer is not connected (nodata_connect): there is no anonymous local seal. Given a folder, seals only the files the scan finds exposure in; given a file, seals that file. ASKS FIRST: without confirm:true it only lists what would be sealed and changes nothing — show that list to the user and call again with confirm:true only after they approve. Writes a local receipt (hashes, seal ids) under <folder>/.nodata/receipts. remove:true also deletes the plaintext originals. For a file ONLY the person should hold (Holder Lock: their own code opens it; the organisation recovers it only through a request, an approver and their window to refuse), tell them to run `npx -y @nodatachat/mcp@latest hold <file>` in their own terminal: the code is typed hidden there. Never ask for that code in the chat.

confirm.description: true = do it. Omit to preview.

remove.description: Delete the plaintext originals after sealing. Default false.

name: nodata_protect
title: Seal files on this computer
